description: Multi-perspective structural analysis for complex social, economic, philosophical, and systemic questions — produces stratified, fact-bound, confidence-calibrated conclusions via multi-lens analysis + structural tools + adversarial prior checks. Invoke when the user asks for deep analysis, multi-angle exploration, structural understanding, or application of specific frameworks (三向, 不对称检测, 博弈分析) — especially on power structures, systemic contradictions, or why-things-are-the-way- they-are. Standalone '为什么'/'你怎么看' only trigger on complex topics, not trivial factual queries. Uses web search for grounding, disciplinary lenses (scaled by depth tier), and structural frameworks (三向, 80/20, asymmetry detection, incentive mapping, path dependency) for stratified conclusions.
